ui.title: Konzertmeister MCP
ui.rename_hint: Only for you – shown on this page and in Home Assistant. Empty = the name in Konzertmeister.
ui.no_key: No API key saved yet – the AI cannot use Konzertmeister.
ui.key_how: A leader of the association creates the key in the Konzertmeister web app: association details → Edit → section “Public API” (help). It is shown only once – paste it here right away. The app checks it with Konzertmeister and keeps it inside the app only.
ui.key_stored: ✅ API key saved (it is never shown again). Association:
ui.key_rejected: Konzertmeister rejects the saved API key (deleted or recreated?). Enter the current key.
ui.delete_key_confirm: Delete the API key of this association? The AI can no longer use Konzertmeister until you enter a key again.
ui.create_incomplete: Creating appointments is allowed, but the creator e-mail or the templates are missing (section “Creating appointments”).
ui.tools_intro: Only ticked tools exist for the AI. New associations start with reading only and without the member list.
ui.confirm_note: Before creating or changing anything, the AI is told to show you what it is about to send and to wait for your yes. It still acts with the rights of the API key – only allow what you need.
ui.groups_intro: Limit appointments, replies and attendance to some groups (e.g. only the youth band). Nothing ticked = all groups.
ui.groups_none: No groups known yet – save a key or click “Load groups again”.
ui.include_without_group: Also appointments without a group (for the whole association)
ui.groups_members_note: The member list cannot be limited to groups – Konzertmeister always returns every member of the association.
ui.members_intro: Names are always shared. Everything else only if ticked – in the member list and in replies and attendance.
ui.gdpr_note: Everything shared here goes to the provider of your AI assistant. Only share what you really need and what your association allows (GDPR) – for minors in particular.
ui.creator_mail_hint: E-mail address of the Konzertmeister account that appears as creator of new appointments (required by Konzertmeister).
ui.templates_hint: One per line: name = template id from Konzertmeister. The API can only create appointments from templates; place, group, duration and deadlines come from the template.
ui.types_hint: One per line: name = number. Konzertmeister needs the numbers to list appointments but offers no list of them. Without entries the numbers 1–10 are asked for.
ui.connector_url: Connector URL for your AI assistant
ui.no_base_url: Your public Home Assistant address is not known yet – it appears as soon as the helper integration runs, or set “Public address” in the configuration.
ui.test_public: Connector URL reachable from the internet
ui.detail_server_off: not running (no key or switched off)
ui.detail_blocked_proxy: blocked before Home Assistant (HTTP {value}, e.g. Cloudflare bot protection) – AI apps usually still get through
ui.detail_no_config_access: no access to the Home Assistant configuration folder
ui.rotate_confirm: Create a new connector URL? The old one stops working right away – replace it in your AI apps.
ui.remove_confirm: Remove “{name}” including its API key and settings?
ui.add_club_hint: For a further association with its own API key, its own connector URL and its own switch in Home Assistant.
ui.load_warning: Every association runs its own server. From four associations on this needs noticeably more memory and CPU – keep an eye on your Home Assistant.
ui.remote_restart_needed: Home Assistant must be restarted once
ui.restart_hint: The app installed or updated its small helper integration. Restart Home Assistant (Settings → System → top right ⋮ → Restart Home Assistant) – afterwards the connector URL works.
ui.secret_warning: The connector URL is the only key to the data – share it with nobody and create a new one if in doubt.
ui.steps: In your AI app add a custom connector (e.g. Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector) and paste the connector URL. No sign-in is needed.
ui.no_public_url: Set “Public address” in the configuration to see the full connector URL.
ui.cleaned_up: The helper integration was removed (remote access: direct).
ui.public_url_http: The public address uses http – AI apps need https.
ui.public_url_invalid: The public address in the configuration is invalid and is ignored.
ui.admins_note: Only Home Assistant administrators can open this page.
ui.ok_refreshed: Name, groups and types loaded from Konzertmeister.
ui.ok_rotate: New connector URL created – replace it in your AI apps.
ui.err_csrf: The page was out of date – please try again.
ui.err_last_club: The last association cannot be removed – delete its key instead.
ui.err_key_format: That does not look like an API key.
ui.err_key_rejected: Konzertmeister rejected this key. Is it complete and current?
ui.err_key_check: The key could not be checked – Konzertmeister was not reachable. Try again.
ui.err_creator_mail: The creator e-mail is not a valid address – nothing was saved.
ui.internal_url: Target address for your own hostname
ui.internal_hint: Route your public HTTPS hostname (e.g. Cloudflare Tunnel) to this address. Never open port 8100 on your router without HTTPS.

tools.get_appointment_replies: Replies to an appointment (yes / no / maybe)
